Everything else in this directory arrived by walking their imports.

Licences: TipTap MIT (LICENSE beside this file); ProseMirror MIT; linkifyjs MIT.

WHY ESM AND AN IMPORT MAP, when every other vendored library here is a UMD
bundle loaded with a plain <script src>:

  TipTap v3 is ESM-only. v2 ships a UMD build, but it expects ProseMirror as
  BARE GLOBALS (window.state, window.model, window.view) — not a supported
  distribution path, and one broken sibling would be silent. There is no
  bundler in this repo and adding one is a bigger change than an import map.

  Bare specifiers survive collectstatic untouched: Django's
  support_js_module_import_aggregation is off, so nothing tries to rewrite
  them, and toto.core.storage.ResilientManifestStaticFilesStorage would
  swallow the failure even if it did. The map itself is rendered from
  cyprian/tiptap.py with {% static %} URLs, so every module is cache-busted.

  .mjs IS NEVER USED HERE, deliberately. Production serves /static/ straight
  from nginx:latest with stock mime.types, which has no .mjs entry — the file
  would go out as application/octet-stream and the browser would refuse the
  module. Whitenoise (dev) knows .mjs, so the break would appear only in
  production. linkifyjs ships its ESM as dist/linkify.mjs; it is vendored here
  as linkifyjs.js.

The trailing //# sourceMappingURL= comment is stripped from every file: we do
not vendor the .map, and the resilient storage would rather not see it.

NOT fetched by zenobia/scripts/download_vendor.py — that writes into the
VENDORED toto library tree, and dirtying vendor/toto_libs blocks every pinned
build and freezes subtree pulls. Same reasoning as
toto/canasta/static/canasta/vendor/pixi/VERSION.txt.

Refresh with scripts/fetch_tiptap.py beside this app (run by hand, never at
build time), then re-run toto.cyprian.tests.test_tiptap.
